title_en: Apartment for sale 3+1+2 at New Boulevard!!
description_en: Apartment for sale 3+1+2 at New Boulevard!! Apartment for sale 3+1+2 at New Boulevard!! The apartment is organized with a total area of ​​147.07 m2, and a net area of ​​126.7 m2. It is organized in a distribution corridor, a spacious living room, with a separate kitchen with windows, and a balcony, with access from the living room. A day toilet positioned in the middle of the apartment, two bedrooms. The third bedroom has a bathroom with a window and a balcony with access only from this room. The apartment is located on the 2nd residential floor, and has a South-West orientation. For more information you can contact us!!
